name: Citicoline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Neurological and cognitive disorders after stroke or head injury (oral)

common: None listed as common (all reactions very rare)

pk.metabolism: Gut wall and liver to choline and cytidine
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Under 3% of dose in urine and feces combined; about 12% as exhaled CO2

sources.citation: Tecnimede España Industria Farmacéutica, S.A. (2015). Citicolina TecniGen 1000 mg solución oral EFG [Ficha técnica (summary of product characteristics); text revised December 2015]. Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios (AEMPS), CIMA registration 80483.
